coverage_gaps: PubMed-only retrieval may omit relevant preprints, clinical-trial registries, regulatory assessments, proteomic repositories, and structural database records.
Rare variants and ancestry-specific risk estimates may remain underpowered or inconsistently classified across cohorts.
Physiological substrate evidence may be tissue-, stimulus-, species-, assay-, or inhibitor-dependent, limiting inference to human nigral neurons and sporadic Parkinson disease.
The search can establish mechanistic plausibility and constraints but cannot by itself prove that Rab phosphorylation is the singular causal pathway from LRRK2 variation to neurodegeneration.
exclusion_criteria: Records lacking a substantive connection to both LRRK2 biology and Parkinson disease or a directly relevant mechanistic intermediate.
Claims based solely on overexpressed protein interactions without phosphorylation-site evidence, perturbational support, or independent physiological validation.
Variant reports without adequate nomenclature, genotyping evidence, association context, segregation data, or interpretable functional testing.
Non-PubMed source routes and records published after the as-of date.
Narrative assertions for which neither the article nor an identifiable supporting primary citation can be retrieved.
Duplicate reports of the same cohort or experiment when they add no new population, method, endpoint, or limitation evidence.
inclusion_criteria: PubMed-indexed records published on or before 2024-12-31.
Human genetic studies that report linkage, segregation, association, ancestry, penetrance, clinical phenotype, or neuropathology for LRRK2 variants.
Biochemical or structural studies that directly measure LRRK2 kinase activity, nucleotide handling, oligomeric state, autophosphorylation, or variant effects.
Cellular, animal, or human-tissue studies that test endogenous candidate-substrate phosphorylation with genetic perturbation, selective inhibition, phosphosite mapping, or orthogonal validation.
Reviews may orient terminology and citation chaining, while mechanistic claims require support from primary studies whenever available.
Studies reporting null, conflicting, context-dependent, adverse, or non-generalizable findings are eligible and tracked alongside supportive evidence.

queries.purpose: Locate high-level reviews and landmark articles spanning genetics, enzymology, substrates, and disease mechanism.
queries.query: ("Leucine-Rich Repeat Kinase 2"[Mesh] OR LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND ("Parkinson Disease"[Mesh] OR Parkinson*[tiab]) AND (genetic*[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Recover the PARK8 linkage-to-gene discovery sequence and original family evidence.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (linkage[tiab] OR segregation[tiab] OR mutation*[tiab] OR "autosomal dominant"[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR parkinsonism[tiab]) AND (2002:2006[dp])

queries.purpose: Map established disease-associated coding variants to segregation, pathogenicity, frequency, and penetrance evidence.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441C[tiab] OR R1441G[tiab] OR R1441H[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab] OR N1437H[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab] OR pathogenic*[tiab] OR penetrance[tiab])

queries.purpose: Distinguish ancestry-enriched susceptibility alleles and association signals from highly penetrant pathogenic variants.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (G2385R[tiab] OR R1628P[tiab] OR M1646T[tiab] OR "risk variant"[tiab] OR susceptibility[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab]) AND (ancestry[tiab] OR population[tiab] OR association[tiab] OR meta-analysis[pt])

queries.purpose: Define the bidomain enzymatic mechanism and compare how kinase-domain and Roc-COR pathogenic variants alter activity.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (kinase[tiab] OR "Roc GTPase"[tiab] OR ROC-COR[tiab] OR "COR domain"[tiab] OR GTPase[tiab]) AND (G2019S[tiab] OR R1441*[tiab] OR Y1699C[tiab] OR I2020T[tiab] OR mechanism*[tiab])

queries.purpose: Confirm structural and biochemical support for activation, oligomerization, nucleotide cycling, and kinase regulation.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (autophosphorylation[tiab] OR dimerization[tiab] OR "GTP binding"[tiab] OR "GTP hydrolysis"[tiab] OR phosphosite*[tiab]) AND (biochemical[tiab] OR structural[tiab] OR cryo-EM[tiab] OR kinetics[tiab])

queries.purpose: Identify proposed physiological Rab substrates and the experimental routes used to discover them.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (substrate*[tiab] OR phosphoproteom*[tiab]) AND (Rab8A[tiab] OR Rab10[tiab] OR Rab12[tiab] OR Rab29[tiab] OR Rab35[tiab] OR Rab43[tiab] OR "Rab GTPase"[tiab])

queries.purpose: Test physiological substrate status through endogenous phosphorylation, genetic loss, inhibitor response, tissue detection, and target-engagement evidence.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (Rab10[tiab] OR Rab8A[tiab] OR "phospho-Rab"[tiab]) AND (endogenous[tiab] OR physiological[tiab] OR stoichiometry[tiab] OR inhibitor[tiab] OR knockout[tiab] OR biomarker[tiab])

queries.purpose: Connect substrate phosphorylation to trafficking, lysosomal homeostasis, autophagy, mitophagy, and ciliogenesis phenotypes.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (Rab*[tiab] OR RILPL1[tiab] OR RILPL2[tiab]) AND (lysosom*[tiab] OR endolysosom*[tiab] OR autophag*[tiab] OR mitophag*[tiab] OR cili*[tiab] OR vesicle trafficking[tiab])

queries.purpose: Retrieve human evidence that limits a uniform genotype-to-mechanism-to-pathology interpretation.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND Parkinson*[tiab] AND ("incomplete penetrance"[tiab] OR pathology[tiab] OR neuropatholog*[tiab] OR phenocopy[tiab] OR heterogeneity[tiab] OR asymptomatic[tiab])

queries.purpose: Find null, discordant, model-specific, and safety-related evidence that constrains causal or therapeutic generalization.
queries.query: LRRK2[tiab] AND (substrate*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR Rab10[tiab]) AND ("negative result"[tiab] OR contradictory[tiab] OR limitation*[tiab] OR "model-dependent"[tiab] OR knockout[tiab] OR toxicity[tiab] OR lung[tiab] OR kidney[tiab])

queries.purpose: Capture recent syntheses, replications, human biomarker studies, and mechanism revisions through the as-of date.
queries.query: (LRRK2[tiab] OR PARK8[tiab]) AND (Parkinson*[tiab]) AND (variant*[tiab] OR kinase[tiab] OR Rab*[tiab] OR substrate*[tiab] OR penetrance[tiab]) AND (2022/01/01:2024/12/31[dp])

question_frame: As of 2024-12-31, trace how LRRK2/PARK8 was genetically linked to Parkinson disease, distinguish pathogenic and risk-associated variants, explain Roc-COR GTPase and kinase regulation and downstream biology, assess evidence for physiological Rab and other substrates, and identify penetrance, ancestry, model-system, pathology, target-engagement, and causal-inference limitations using PubMed-indexed human, biochemical, cellular, animal, review, and replication evidence.
stop_rules: Stop discovery-wave searching when every concept block has at least one eligible primary source and one independent confirming or challenging source where such evidence exists.

Stop variant expansion when the major established pathogenic variants and major ancestry-enriched risk alleles are classified with evidence type, population context, and penetrance or effect-size caveats.

Stop substrate searching when each retained physiological substrate has explicit evidence for phosphosite identity, endogenous occurrence, LRRK2 dependence, and relevant cellular or tissue context, or is labeled as incompletely validated.
Stop citation chaining after two consecutive query or reference-chaining passes yield no new eligible mechanistic claim, variant class, physiological substrate, or material limitation.
Stop at 12 query events, even if saturation has not been reached, and report unresolved domains as coverage gaps.
Do not extend retrieval beyond records published on 2024-12-31.
